headline: Two workers die in blast after re-entering quake-hit Japanese mall on boss's order
summary: Two store employees were killed when an explosion tore through Kumamoto's Aeon Mall after a magnitude 6.8 quake; their employer has apologised for ordering them back inside.
script: Two workers died in an explosion at a quake-damaged mall in Kumamoto, Japan. Their boss had asked them to go back inside to move cash to a safe. The company has apologised, saying the instructions were not worth a life.
imageAlt: The damaged facade of the Aeon Mall in Kumamoto after the blast.
imageAltTwo: A wider view of the Aeon Mall showing twisted metal and torn cladding.
